[[Gerlinda Korbauch]] is a collector, a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for weapons.

==Locations==
*[[Echovald Forest]]
**{{NPC location|Durheim Archives}}

==Dialogue==
:''"You can never be sure where they're hiding. They sneak up when you least expect and cleave your noggin clean off! What in Grenth's name am I talking about? Mantises, of course! I've been scheming to eradicate them for years, and I think they're finally on to me. I can't go anywhere these days without being chased by swarms of them! If I can collect enough of their pincers, I should be able to grind them into an aromatic powder that will disguise my scent. They'll think I'm one of them! Then I can infiltrate their hive and exterminate the buggers once and for all. Bring me 5 Mantis Pincers, and I'll reward your service with this:"''
